thread:
ravi: beginning RC origination for v2.15.0-candA. Targeting 08:45 PT change window. Artifacts: gcr.io/redwood/serving@sha:ff12aa. Need pin request and quick QA signoff.

zoe: build passed. integration and perf smoke ran in staging. Created release notes stub: https://docs.internal/releases/v2.15.0.

sam: +1 to pin but please note the new batching config in PR #4218 might affect latency. I'm going to run a short perf check.

deploybot: /promote candidate v2.15.0-candA --pin --canary=5% --canary-duration=20m --kv-warm=true
deploybot: Promotion queued -> job_id=78111. Logs: https://deploys.internal/jobs/78111/logs

deploybot: job 78111 started: deploy->smoke->canary

sam: perf check started: /run-perf --focus batches --duration 3m

deploybot: smoke result PASS. Canary ramp to 5% in progress.

zoe: seeing slight increase in p99 on /v1/generate (200ms -> 340ms). Not critical but above our soft threshold. Holding ramp at 5% while we inspect.

ravi: can you capture flamegraphs? Could be kernel switch on the new batching.

sam: grabbed heap+cpu samples and an application trace. Looks like new batching introduces additional copy when input size < 32 tokens. I'll try toggling the batching window to confirm.

deploybot: alert: canary error spike detected job 78111 -> 4xx/5xx on a small subset (rate 0.9%). Rolling hold.

oncall-sre: quick triage: errors are 400-like "bad request - tokenizer mismatch" coming from the pre-tokenize shim. Hypothesis: older clients sending legacy streaming prefix.

zoe: interesting, dataset shows malformed prefix on 0.4% of requests. Might be unrelated. Recommendation: pause promotion and roll back to stable until we confirm.

ravi: safety vote: zoe=+1 pause, sam=+1 pause, ravi?

ravi: +1 pause. Abort canary and rollback. We'll mark candidate as held.

deploybot: /rollback job 78111 --reason "canary tokenizer mismatch errors"
deploybot: rollback completed -> SUCCESS. Traffic restored. KV-warm invalidation scheduled.

sam: I'll open a hotfix PR to adjust batching copy path and add a compatibility check for legacy streaming prefixes. ETA ~40m. Also adding an additional pre-promote test that simulates legacy clients.

release-manager: updated release tracker: v2.15.0-candA status=hold. New proposed cut if hotfix validated: 10:30 PT. Added action items and owners.

zoe: follow-up: add a small perf guard in the deploy pipeline that checks p99 increase >25% as a hard gate. We nearly promoted with elevated p99.

ravi: agreed. Thanks everyone. Ill wait for hotfix CI and then we can re-request pin. Short summary pushed to the release doc. :white_check_mark:
